CanDescription: An empty can. Useful enough to keep, common enough to explain why your bag is full.
FishDescription: A freshly caught fish. Fishing is a relaxing hobby, provided you are not the fish.
CookedFishDescription: A cooked fish, ready to eat. A convincing reason to call the last hour of fishing meal preparation.
PurpleOreDescription: Purple ore for smelting. A little colour makes another bag of rocks feel like a collection.
WhiteOreDescription: Pale ore for smelting. Looks clean. Your work clothes will tell a different story.
CopperOreDescription: Copper ore for the furnace. The first step towards a finished bar is carrying a surprisingly heavy rock.
BlackOreDescription: Dark ore for smelting. Another good reason to wash your hands before lunch.
ChamomileDescription: A small flower with a familiar herbal scent. Gathering it counts as work. Sitting beside it apparently does not.
WoodDescription: A solid piece of wood. Many useful things start here, usually with someone saying it will be a quick job.
RiceDescription: Plain rice. Not much of a meal yet, but a respectable start and no complicated opinions.
SushiDescription: Rice and fish, neatly rolled. The same ingredients, with noticeably more effort put into lunch.
PurpleBarDescription: A bar smelted from purple ore. The rocks are now tidy enough to call them supplies.
WhiteBarDescription: A bar smelted from white ore. Clean edges, pale finish, and actual work to show for the afternoon.
CopperBarDescription: A copper bar ready for crafting. Keeping a spare is sensible. Defining spare is where things get expensive.
BlackBarDescription: A bar smelted from black ore. Compact, solid, and still too heavy to forget in your pocket.
HealthPotionDescription: Restores health. A useful backup for the plan where you were not going to get hit.

CurrencyDescription: Money for purchases. Much easier to spend than to explain where it all went.
LogWelcome: Welcome to ChillDuck. One thing at a time.
ProfessionLevelRequired: Your level is too low to gather this resource. Required: {0}, current: {1}.
XpDescription: Experience is gained through completing tasks, gathering resources, and crafting items. Gained experience contributes to skill level growth, allowing access to more advanced actions and better rewards.
IronHelmetDescription: An iron helmet. Protects your head; the decisions made inside it remain your responsibility.
IronChestDescription: An iron chestplate covering several things you would prefer to keep intact. Worth the extra weight.
IronBootsDescription: Sturdy iron boots. Getting ready for trouble now sounds a lot like walking across the room.
IronSwordDescription: A straightforward iron sword. Requires practice, maintenance, and a clear idea of which end to hold.
AmmoTemplateDescription: An empty special gear slot for weapon support items.
AmmoArrow1Description: An arrow for a bow. Fits the ammo slot. Aim first; walking over to retrieve it comes later.
AmmoArrow2Description: An arrow for a bow. Fits the ammo slot. Aim first; walking over to retrieve it comes later.
AmmoArrow3Description: An arrow for a bow. Fits the ammo slot. Aim first; walking over to retrieve it comes later.
AmmoRune1Description: A rune for the ammo slot. A little preparation for when a pointed look is not enough.
AmmoRune2Description: A rune for the ammo slot. A little preparation for when a pointed look is not enough.
AmmoRune3Description: A rune for the ammo slot. A little preparation for when a pointed look is not enough.
AmmoFeather1Description: A feather for the ammo slot. At least one piece of equipment is taking the weight problem seriously.
AmmoFeather2Description: A feather for the ammo slot. At least one piece of equipment is taking the weight problem seriously.
AmmoFeather3Description: A feather for the ammo slot. At least one piece of equipment is taking the weight problem seriously.
AmmoOil1Description: Weapon oil for the ammo slot. Maintaining a blade is less exciting than using it, which is part of the appeal.
AmmoOil2Description: Weapon oil for the ammo slot. Maintaining a blade is less exciting than using it, which is part of the appeal.
AmmoOil3Description: Weapon oil for the ammo slot. Maintaining a blade is less exciting than using it, which is part of the appeal.
IronWandDescription: An iron wand for casting spells. Looking thoughtful while holding it is the easy part.
IronBowDescription: An iron-reinforced bow. Aiming takes patience. Fetching arrows takes more.
StrengthPotionDescription: Temporarily increases Strength. Another dose refreshes the duration of the active effect. Confidence is not a substitute for checking the weight first.
SpeedPotionDescription: Temporarily increases Speed. Another dose refreshes the duration of the active effect. For when leaving five minutes earlier is no longer an option.

FarmDescription: Grow herbs and fruit from seeds. Farm levels provide 2, 4 or 6 slots. Crops grow while you are offline and wait for harvest. Finally, something on your list that works while you rest.
ChamomileSeedDescription: Place seeds in a farm slot. Each growth cycle uses one seed. A small investment in having more to pick later.
StrawberryDescription: A freshly picked strawberry. Keeping some for later is the difficult part of farming.
StrawberrySeedDescription: Place seeds in a farm slot. Each growth cycle uses one seed. A small investment in having more to pick later.
MintDescription: Fresh mint with a crisp scent. A small harvest that makes the whole bag smell productive.
MintSeedDescription: Place seeds in a farm slot. Each growth cycle uses one seed. A small investment in having more to pick later.
LavenderDescription: Freshly gathered lavender. Smells like a quiet afternoon, even when yours involves sorting inventory.
LavenderSeedDescription: Place seeds in a farm slot. Each growth cycle uses one seed. A small investment in having more to pick later.
CalendulaDescription: Bright calendula flowers. Evidence that a patch of dirt can look better after you have worked on it.
CalendulaSeedDescription: Place seeds in a farm slot. Each growth cycle uses one seed. A small investment in having more to pick later.
RaspberryDescription: A freshly picked raspberry. Small enough to underestimate, good enough to pick another.
RaspberrySeedDescription: Place seeds in a farm slot. Each growth cycle uses one seed. A small investment in having more to pick later.
HideoutSeedHint: Drag a seed stack here or right-click seeds in your inventory. Right-click this slot to withdraw seeds. A ready crop waits for harvest.
HideoutStaleState: The farm has changed. Review the refreshed slots and try again.
HideoutInventoryFull: Not enough room for this stack or harvest.
HelpGear:
Equipment
Tab: toggle equipment.

HelpCharacter:
Character
Review character statistics and profession levels.

C: toggle this window.
HelpQuest:
Quests
Read the objective and requirements.

Accept: start the quest.
Complete: turn in a finished quest.

Collect quests need the required items in your inventory.
HelpMerchant:
Merchant
Hover over an item to inspect it.

Right-click an offer: buy.
Drag & drop between shop and inventory: buy or sell.
HelpCrafting:
Crafting & farm
Choose a recipe and review its materials and result.

Craft: create the selected item.
Farm: drag seeds into a slot, or right-click seeds in inventory.
Right-click a farm slot: withdraw seeds.
HelpStash:
Account stash
Drag & drop: move items between stash and inventory.

Right-click: transfer a stack.
Alt + right-click: split a stash stack.
HelpInventory:
Inventory
B: toggle inventory.

Drag & drop: move, equip or transfer items.
Right-click: use an item or transfer it to the open stash, farm or trade.

Alt + right-click: split a stack outside trade.

Party

Accept / decline: respond to an invitation.
Leave: exit the party.

Member actions depend on your role.

Trade
